   legged robots, deformable mechanisms, etc.

•  AI methods can learn dynamics directly from data.
•  Neural networks can approximate: inverse dynamics,
   forward dynamics, friction effects, and residual modelling
    errors.

Deep Lagrangian NN: Physics into the Network Architecture

Deep Lagrangian Neural Network is a learning approach
where it learns the physics structure that generates
torque rather than directly learning torque from input data.

The Central Idea of DeLaN:
Instead of learning: NN(Θ, ሶΘ, ሷΘ) → τ (black box)
DeLaN learns:
        NN₁(Θ) → H(𝜣) — Symmetric and Positive Definite
                     mass matrix
       NN₂(Θ) → V(𝜣) — the potential energy
And then derives τ from these using the Euler-Lagrange
equation.
• DeLaN only requires configuration(Θ) as input.
